label: lem:const_outside_ball
title: Lemma
body_md:
\label{lem:const_outside_ball}
  If $u_0 \in C^{0,1}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ is constant outside a ball $B_L(0)$ for some $L > 0$ then it holds that $u_{h}$ and $u_{h,R}$ are also constant on $\big(\mathbb{R}^d \setminus B_L(0) \big)\times [0, \infty)$.

label: eq:zero_level_of_u_0
title: Lemma
body_md:
Let $\Omega_0 \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ be a bounded set with $C^3$ boundary. Then there exists a function $u_0 \in C^3_b(\mathbb{R}^d\setminus S) \cap C^{0,1}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ where $S$ is closed and satisfies $\overline{\mathbb{R}^\setminus S} = \mathbb{R}^d$ and a scalar $R > 0$ with 
  \begin{align}
    \{ u_0 > 0 \} &= \Omega_0, \label{eq:zero_level_of_u_0}\\
    u_0 &\equiv -1 \quad \quad \text{ on } \mathbb{R}^d \setminus B_R(0), \label{eq:const_out_u_0}\\
    \sup_{h \in (0, 1]} \int_{\mathbb{R}^d} \left| \frac{1}{\sqrt{h}}\int_{\mathbb{R}^d} G_h(x,y) \mathop \mathrm{sign}(u_0(x) - u_0(y)) \, dy \right| \, dx &< \infty \label{eq:L1_u_0},\\
    \sup_{h \in (0,1]} E_h(u_0) < \infty \label{eq:energy_bound_u_0}.
  \end{align}
